notes: Safety Tracker v2.10.91 CLEAN. Reporting defaults from active position(s)/managed departments with My positions, individual department and All site filters; scoped report exports use the same filter. Evidence Pack is person-first and shows only documents/training assigned directly, by department or Everyone, plus linked supporting controlled documents. People defaults to Active with Disabled, Recommended delete/anonymise and All filters. Disabled-user retention review uses a configurable 6-year general Safety Tracker evidence policy from the later of disable date/latest personal evidence, supports explicit retention holds, and never auto-deletes.
